<!-- For suspected vulnerabilities, use SECURITY.md and its private-reporting
instructions. Do not include credentials or unnecessary personal data here. -->

## Provider and record

Jurisdiction, provider/dataset, record identifier, revision/date selector, and
project version/commit if applicable:

## Observed discrepancy

What did the project return or document? Include a small sanitized example.
Do not paste bulk source payloads.

## Authoritative source

Source URL, relevant original fields or provision, and date accessed:

## Expected interpretation and uncertainty

Explain what the source establishes, what is inferred, and what remains unclear.
Do not guess missing legal facts.

## Retrieval context

When observed, whether the result was cached/stale if known, and reproduction
steps using existing evidence or a fixture. Do not repeatedly query a live
provider just to complete this report.
